STRUCTURAL.why: Q80 mixed is 1-bit sign * fp16 group scale (element-wise). DSV4F is e2m1 nibble * e8m0 after a 32-wide block sum, times a separate e4m3 activation scale. Different association. A shared inner FMA would change hc_sha / greedy logits.

Q80 consumes f32 x (intensity ~1 flop/byte, no extra traffic). DSV4F must act-quant bf16->e4m3+e8m0 (extra bytes + extra kernel) before the matvec. Folding act-quant into Q80 would cost bandwidth. Forbidden.
No DSV4F equivalent. Serial bitstream decode + scatter-add.
Factorized rank-160 down_proj. DSV4F down is a single FP4 matvec. The *factor* matvec is CONSTANT-DIFF; the fused two-stage is not.

STRUCTURAL.what: DSV4F MHC + sparse attention vs Qwen GQA / DeltaNet
STRUCTURAL.why: Different operators. G014 already said Q38 DeltaNet is Q80 DeltaNet. DSV4F attention is MHC. Do not abstract.

STRUCTURAL.what: DSV4F learned-bias / hash route vs Q80 softmax top-10
STRUCTURAL.why: Different router math. Worklist *envelope* is CONSTANT-DIFF; the score function is not.
Q80 is 256-thread tree reduce, f32, *(1+w). DSV4F authority is single-thread left-fold, bf16 RNE, *w. Same formula family, different association. Unifying the reduction would change bits.
DE-AUTHORISED. Leave the source. Do not put it in the family.

One matvec family with kCodec in {BINARY_GROUP, HGRAVS01, FP4_E2M1} and kTile in {SERIAL, SIMD, ROWBLOCK4}. Each combo is a compiled specialization with its own inner loop (function constants, not runtime branch).
SwiGLU / combine / pack_worklist as CONSTANT-DIFF specializations.
Wire qwen80_mixed_hybrid_decode and dsv4f native token graph through decode_family (same Rust path, specialized Metal).
Relax Q38 refuse gates: DeltaNet 32 or 48 heads; GQA 16:2@5e6 or 24:4@1e7; values_per_key_head 2 or 3.
do_not: Do not merge rice CSR, two-stage L@(R@x), MHC, act-quant, FP8 block-128, or Q4 into the family.
Do not put a codec switch inside the FMA.
Do not add dummy weight/activation traffic to make ABIs look the same.
Do not wait for model artifacts.

bandwidth_note: batch=1 decode is ~1 flop/byte. Shared source that compiles out unused codecs does not move extra bytes. A runtime codec branch or a union-of-all-buffers inner loop would. Family specializations bind only the pointers that specialization reads.
